data.body: SPEC AMENDMENT from 94ed-f55c-51f5-45f6 brainstorm: 94ed defines intent_id format as STABLE slug (regex [a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+){2,5}) minted at item creation — not ordinal references like SC-1 or DoD-2.a. d566's Rule 6 (in behavioral-testing-standard.md) was originally drafted assuming ordinal references; this amendment updates Rule 6 to consume stable slug intent_ids from 94ed's manifest. Recoverable since d566 has not yet been preplanned or implemented. When d566 enters preplanning, update Rule 6's intent_id field description and accept/reject examples to use stable slug format.
